domain_description: How learners encode, store, and retrieve information — and the teaching moves that exploit how memory actually works. All interventions cross-referenced to peer-reviewed meta-analyses.

skills.description: Schedule retrieval intervals across a unit so learning is distributed, not massed.
skills.implementation_cost_rationale: Runs inside existing lessons; only requires re-sequencing of planned retrieval, no new materials.

skills.description: Analyse a learning task for cognitive load problems and recommend specific design improvements.
skills.implementation_cost_rationale: Requires teacher understanding of CLT principles (split-attention, redundancy, modality); applying analysis to existing tasks takes prep time but no structural changes.
